title: ORP v0.3 attestation block (RFC change C1)
description: Cryptographic attestation over an ORP document, aligned with AdCP #4441. A detached Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 canonical form of the document minus this block, with a purpose-constrained short-lived key. This schema validates SHAPE only; semantic verification (hash recompute, signature, expiry, key-purpose) is performed by orp_validator.attestation.verify_attestation.

hash.description: sha256 over the canonical serialisation of the attested content (RFC 8785).

previous_hash.description: Hash of the prior version; null for version 1.

tier.description: Trust tier (RFC change C7). self_declared needs no valid signature; attested/verified/full do.

kid.description: Key id resolvable to an Ed25519 public key: a did:web / did:key, or a JWKS key id on the kid's host.

use.description: Key-purpose constraint (mirrors AdCP adcp_use: provenance-claim). A key MUST NOT be accepted for a purpose it is not marked for.

sig.description: base64url detached Ed25519 signature over the RFC 8785 canonical bytes of the attested content.

role.description: Who this key speaks for, e.g. data_steward / verifier / rail / licensee / licensor.

key_expires.description: Short-lived key posture (RFC §2.4): a verifier MUST reject a signature whose key_expires is in the past (with reasonable skew).
